camel_example: aliyun agentidentity SetUserPassword --region cn-hangzhou --UserName alice --GenerateRandomPassword false --UserPoolName 'my-agent-userpool' --Password 'P@ssw0rd!2026' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the logon password of a user
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity set-user-password --user-name alice --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --password 'P@ssw0rd!2026' --generate-random-password false --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetUserPassword

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the user. The password must comply with the password policy of the user pool and is mutually exclusive with GenerateRandomPassword
parameters.help_zh: 用户密码。需符合用户池的密码策略，与 GenerateRandomPassword 互斥
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate a random password. If this parameter is set to true, the system automatically generates a random password that complies with the password policy. This parameter is mutually exclusive with Password
parameters.help_zh: 是否生成随机密码。设置为 true 时系统自动生成符合密码策略的随机密码，与 Password 互斥
parameters.name: generate_random_password

RandomPassword.description_en: The system-generated random password returned when GenerateRandomPassword is set to true
RandomPassword.description_zh: 当 GenerateRandomPassword 为 true 时返回的系统生成的随机密码
